$comment: BD2 song map (plan docs/plan/2026-11-21-beatdrop-montages.md section 5 BD2, D414). Settings for services/clip/song_map.py: the beat grid (tempo from music_library, then a least-squares fit of period and phase to the onset times), downbeats (the beat phase with the most low-band energy), sections (intro, build, drop, breakdown, outro) from bar energy, the drop times and the strong transients a gunshot can land on. Output is numbers only (schema data/schemas/song-map.schema.json). All values are the agent's proposal, checked on synthetic tracks only; real tracks UNVERIFIED.
